zeroshot.text:
Portrait payment-terminal grip, component/lid side toward the user, bottom shell away:
- **Bottom end = v-max (v=110)**: the detachable keyboard section lives here — J3 keypad header at v 105.73..109.27 [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/geometry_provenance.md:33] and the keypad bay v 58.8..110.0 [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/cad/parameters.py:260]; the device is "held keyboard-down (screen at top, keypad underneath)" [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/AGENTS.md:48-54].
- **Top end = v=0**: the NFC end — coil A1 at v 1.00..41.00 [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/geometry_provenance.md:37]; assembly seats the "NFC end (v=0)" first [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/assembly.md:22].
- **What the user sees**: the lid face — LANDSCAPE OLED window in the upper half (band v 16.6..46.0, centred u=30, flex edge on the +v short edge folding to DS1) [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/geometry_provenance.md:47; /root/src/nucula-enclosure/cad/parameters.py:294-306]; keypad in the lower half; charge LED under a Ø2.2 lid hole at (u 15.5, v 44) [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/assembly.md:38-39; /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/geometry_provenance.md:35].
- **Left edge = u=0**: USB-C J1 mates horizontally from the user's left at v 56.42..67.36 (shell face u −0.80, 26 mm plug reach, 14.2 × 7.71 opening) [citation: /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/geometry_provenance.md:28,45; /root/src/nucula-enclosure/docs/design_spec.md:33-36]; battery JS
